plainText:
Pikala (Japanese: ピカーラ Pikala) is a recurring character who first appeared in A Plethora of Pikachu!. She is a Pokémon Trainer who lives in Pikachu Valley with all of her .

==History==
Pikala debuted in A Plethora of Pikachu!, where she met , , and Mimo when they visited Pikachu Valley. To give her visitors the full experience, she gave them each Pikachu-themed ears and tails to wear as well as giving them their own "Pika-speak" names, Pikash (Japanese: サトピ Satopi), Pikawe (Japanese: カピ Kapi), and Pikamo (Japanese: ホピ Hopi), respectively. Later, when attempted to steal all of the Pikachu, Pikala, with the help of her Pikachu, nicknamed the Boss, sent the trio blasting off using .

She reappeared during a flashback in Beauty is Only Crystal Deep!, where she had her Pikanium Z stolen by a .

In Battle Royal 151!, Pikala entered the Manalo Conference with another one of her Pikachu, named Bolt (Japanese: ボルト Bolt). However, it was defeated by Jessie's Mimikyu during the Battle Royal preliminary round, thus eliminating Pikala from the tournament.

==Character==
Pikala is an eccentric fan of . She even dresses up in a Pikachu outfit and puts "Pika" into all of her sentences, referring to this manner of speech as "Pika-speak". She also has the ability to know which region a Pikachu comes from by touching their fur.

==Trivia==
The Boss, Curly, and Pikala's other wear hairstyles similar to the ones that can be given to the Pikachu and in Pokémon: Let's Go, Pikachu! and Let's Go, Eevee!.
Pikala's way of adding "Pika" to her sentences mimics the mannerisms of Frank, another character of the day from Pokémon the Series: XY who is also a big Pikachu fan.
In the dub, Pikala puts "Chu" into all of her sentences instead of "Pika".
Bolt's haircut and name are the same as those of the character from .
